text:
Maya: Heads-up — we should add an 'adaptive resilience' panel in rollout console to show fallback counts + root cause signals. We keep losing context when routes degrade.
Philip: agree. do you mean per-model / per-route?
Andre: per-route, per-region, and by policy rule. quick mock: `Resilience > Routes > <route>` shows: fallback rate, avg latency pre/post, dominating error code, recent rollouts that triggered.
Maya: +1. Also we need to display which degrade mode ran (quiet degrade / hard degrade / cache-only) — that's the most confusing for SREs.
Andre: exactly. And include link to action: 'Force revert' / 'Simulate' / 'Audit log'
ops-bot: Incident #7382 created from alert: high fallback rate on route `/v1/generate` in eu-west-1
Philip: For the UX: when a fallback policy triggers automatically, we should surface the trigger condition: e.g., `5xx spike > 3% over 2m` or `queue length > 200`. Show the sampled traces.
Andre: How do we handle telemetry retention? per-request sampling can lead to missing evidence for audits.
Maya: propose: deterministic sampling tied to request hash + policy-run-id, so audits can replay same sample set.
Philip: hmm deterministic sampling might leak PII if we keep raw requests in logs. need redaction + short-lived retention.
Maya: agree. retention configs per-tenant: 7/30/90 days. UI should warn when retention < 30d for enterprise.
Andre: API debate: should `GET /policy/{id}/history` include full triggers or only summarize? E.g., full events with `trigger_type`, `signal_value`, `matched_rule`
Philip: I'd vote full events but gated by role and retention. exportable CSV for postmortem.
Maya: UX microcopy: call it 'Resilience audit trail' not 'policy history' — better for compliance.
SRE: +1 on exports, add `replay` button to re-run policy evaluation against archived metrics.
Ops: any objections to adding `simulate` which runs on a dry dataset? Security: we must ensure no writes.
Maya: Simulate should be read-only and require `simulate` permission. Button should be hidden behind a confirm modal.
Philip: small detail — show when a fallback was automatic vs manual. color code: orange auto, blue manual.
Andre: telemetry note: add per-trigger provenance id `trigger_id` in logs so we can link traces -> rollout -> policy rule.
Maya: Also track `decision_latency_ms` for policy evals for perf debugging.
SRE: Good. last point: we need to avoid oscillation — show recent toggles and 'cooldown' status.
Philip: OK next steps: Maya to sketch panel, Andre to spec API changes, Philip to add telemetry proto fields. sync tomorrow 10am.
Maya: thanks — adding a short playbook blurb for ops on how to interpret the panel.
Andre: pinging @security about retention/legal.
security: noted. we'll review retention/PII constraints. might require hashing or k-anon measures.
ops-bot: Reminder: meeting scheduled at 2024-11-12 10:00 UTC
Maya: thanks all :thumbsup:
